result.summary: The intersection provides basic pedestrian infrastructure including a marked crosswalk and sidewalks, but lacks modern safety enhancements. The environment is dominated by vehicular traffic flow, with faded pavement markings and an absence of visible pedestrian signal heads or ADA-compliant curb ramps.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: No dedicated pedestrian signal heads are visible, forcing pedestrians to rely on vehicular traffic lights which may not provide adequate clearance time.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic signal poles at the intersection

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Signal Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian signal heads with countdown timers and accessible push buttons to provide clear crossing intervals.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install or upgrade curb ramps with detectable warning surfaces to ensure the crossing is accessible to all users.

result.summary: The image shows a wide signalized intersection in a residential area with faded crosswalk markings and standard sidewalks. While pedestrian signals are present, the long crossing distance and lack of physical protection like medians or curb extensions increase pedestrian exposure to traffic.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The zebra-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn and faded, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Long Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The wide roadway requires pedestrians to be exposed to traffic for a significant duration without a refuge island.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility continental crosswalk markings to improve driver awareness and compliance.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Construct a median refuge island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time, reducing exposure.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the corners to shorten the crossing distance and improve sight lines between pedestrians and drivers.

result.summary: The intersection is highly vehicle-oriented, lacking basic pedestrian safety features such as marked crosswalks and dedicated signals despite the presence of traffic lights. Sidewalks are discontinuous or in poor condition, forcing pedestrians into the roadway or onto unpaved surfaces.

hazards.name: Missing Crosswalks
hazards.description: There are no marked pedestrian crossings at this signalized intersection, increasing the risk of vehicle-pedestrian conflict.
hazards.location_in_image: Center foreground across the main roadway

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Signals
hazards.description: The intersection has vehicle traffic lights but no pedestrian-specific signals to indicate when it is safe to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Traffic light poles at the intersection

hazards.name: Discontinuous Sidewalk
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the left appears to terminate or degrade into an unpaved area near the intersection.

result.summary: The intersection features basic pedestrian infrastructure including sidewalks, curb ramps, and a marked crosswalk controlled by traffic signals. However, the crosswalk markings are significantly faded, and there is a lack of visible dedicated pedestrian signal heads, which may compromise safety at this crossing adjacent to a recreational area.
